reports.title: Procore Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: •Fourth Quarter 2026 Outlook
section: ◦Revenue is expected to be in the range of $420 million to $422 million, including inorganic revenue from DroneDeploy of $19 million, representing year-over-year growth of 20.3% to 20.9%.
◦Non-GAAP operating margin is expected to be in the range of 15.5% to 16.0%.
◦Revenue is expected to be in the range of $1,557.0 million to $1,559.0 million, including inorganic revenue from DroneDeploy of $24 million, representing year-over-year growth of 17.7% to 17.9%.
◦Non-GAAP operating margin is expected to be in the range of 19.0% to 19.5%.

◦Free cash flow margin is expected to be 18.0%, including approximately $23 million in one-time cash payments related to our acquisition of DroneDeploy. Excluding these one-time cash payments, free cash flow margin is expected to be 19.5%.
◦Non-GAAP operating margin is expected to be 25%.
